body:
Thanks @elad-inferize. The problem here is that I don't think it is always "safe" to truncate the start of the prompt at an arbitrary token boundary.

Please see how I was handling this before https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/blob/e1060a71a1bb96103ce9ca98345184dcdc982467/vllm/v1/engine/detokenizer.py#L183-L192.

So I think something like that would need to be incorporated too.

Could you provide some clear benchmarks to show the benefit with different prompt lengths?

---

Btw I would encourage you to try our rust front-end in which I think we also handle this. `VLLM_USE_RUST_FRONTEND=1`
